messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Cobalt VPC - kv-prefix hit-rate dropped below 15% for tenant 'cobalt-01' across dedicated pool dp-7. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.

maria (oncall): I’m up — looking now. Which pool? dp-7?

aj (sre): yes dp-7. Metrics show prefix hitrate collapse starting ~10:03 UTC, spikes in `kv_evictions` and `prefetch_misses` for prefix `cobalt/*`.

jules (platform): I'm seeing a huge number of long tail `get` latencies for those shards. Probably cache pollution from a noisy query pattern.

maria (oncall): leo, can you confirm customer impact from Cobalt side? pinging customer-cobalt.

leo (cust-eng): customer-cobalt: Cobalt confirms degraded user-facing latencies in their fraud-score endpoint, ~30-50% requests >500ms, occasional 502s. They report a backlog of inference requests.

maria (oncall): ok triage plan: 1) isolate tenant cache (prevent cross-tenant pollution), 2) disable prefetching for cobalt-01, 3) targeted eviction of `cobalt/*` keyspace and bump TTLs, 4) monitor hitrate + latency. aj can you run the evict and disable prefetch?

aj (sre): on it. Will run safe-targeted-evict for prefix `cobalt/*` and patch prefetch config. Pushing commands to dp-7 now.

infra-bot: Running `safe-targeted-evict --pool dp-7 --prefix cobalt/* --rate-limit 200` (started).

aj (sre): patching route: set `prefetch.enabled=false` for tenant cobalt-01 on dp-7 via control plane. Will also set `prefix_ttl_override=30s` to favor quicker turnover.

maria (oncall): good. Also enable tenant isolation mode: divert cobalt traffic to isolated cache namespace to avoid polluting other tenants. jules pls help if we need a quick namespace spin-up.

jules (platform): namespace spin-up done (ns=cobalt-iso-202). Updating routing: `route_prefix(cobalt/*) -> ns=cobalt-iso-202` (applied on dp-7).

aj (sre): evict completed. Sample run output:

```
# safe-targeted-evict output
scanned_keys: 12.3M
evicted_keys: 3.9M
rate_limit: 200/sec
duration: 00:02:18
errors: 0
```

maria (oncall): monitoring dashboards: KV hitrate climbed from 12% -> 62% over 6m after evict + isolation. Latency p95 reduced from 820ms -> 210ms.

customer-cobalt: Confirmed latency improvement on their end, user-facing errors dropped to normal. Thanks.

leo (cust-eng): note: customer asked why this happened — they say they started a new batch job that hammered many rare prefixes. We'll include guidance.

aj (sre): putting a temporary ingress throttle for cobalt-01 for batch jobs. Also added a rate-limited prefetch guard to prevent future floods.

maria (oncall): escalation notes: impact window 10:03-10:12 UTC, ~9m. Affected routes: /fraud/score (handled by dp-7). Customer SLA impact: elevated latency, ~5% 502s.

jules (platform): follow-ups: 1) automatic tenant isolation when prefix eviction rate > threshold, 2) adapt prefetch backoff for high-cardinality prefixes, 3) alert tuning to include `prefetch_misses` ratio.

aj (sre): created runbook snippet and a safe playbook for targeted eviction and isolation. Pushed PR to ops-runbooks: `ops/runbooks/kv/prefix-evict.md` (will link in postmortem).

maria (oncall): notifying customer success + security for postmortem. tagging this thread: incident-followup.

leo (cust-eng): customer requests a short RCA and mitigation summary. I'll coordinate and send draft.

maria (oncall): thanks team. Leaving follow-up tasks:
- aj: finalize runbook + step-by-step evict commands (due +2h)
- jules: implement auto-isolate prototype (due +3d)
- leo: customer-facing note + mitigation guidance (due +1h)
- maria: draft incident timeline and severity justification (due +4h)

maria (oncall): closing slack thread for now, will reopen if regressions. :thumbsup:
